component.name: Mixtapes
component.summary: A modern, Linux-first YouTube Music player

description.p: Mixtapes is a YouTube Music player built with GTK4 and Libadwaita for Linux. Browse your library, search for music, create playlists, and enjoy seamless playback with MPRIS integration, responsive mobile-friendly design, and background playback.
Note: This software is in alpha stage. It is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

A ground-up rework of lyrics: pick which providers to search and in what order, read a romanization or translation under each line, follow word by word timing, and step in yourself when a track matches the wrong song. Plus scrobbling to Last.fm and ListenBrainz, a GNOME HIG primary menu, and a long run of memory and performance work.

ul.li: Scrobbling to Last.fm and ListenBrainz, with Now Playing updates and an offline backlog that retries failed submissions
Lyrics search queue: reorder the providers, switch any of them off, and choose whether the search stops at the first result or keeps looking for one with real timing. Under Preferences, Lyrics
Second line under each lyric: a romanization, a translation, or the backing vocals. Auto picks a romanization for non-Latin scripts and backing vocals otherwise

Romanization is generated on your machine for Korean and Cyrillic, needing no network and no data files. Japanese and Chinese use a provider's own reading, or an installed dictionary when one is available

Apple Music lyrics are now read from the original TTML rather than a flattened copy: word by word timing, official transliterations and translations, backing vocals on their own line, and correct spacing for Japanese and Chinese
Duets are laid out the way Apple credits them, with the second voice against the opposite edge
Instrumental breaks show a marker that fills across the gap as a countdown to the next line, instead of leaving the last sung line lit for twenty seconds
Sources with no word timing get a highlight that travels across the line rather than the whole line lighting at once. Can be switched off

Lyrics effects: each word fades in over the time it is actually held, the line being sung grows, and Full adds a glow and blurs the lines furthest away. Resting and active text sizes are both adjustable

Rebuilt lyrics source picker: see what every provider returned, browse all of one provider's matches when the automatic pick is wrong, search by name for titles that defeat matching, and undo any choice with Use automatic choice
The lyrics button stays reachable when a track has no lyrics, which is when switching source or searching by name actually matters

Fix: Apple Music had been silently unavailable. The developer token it needs is scraped from Apple's web player, and a change there had broken the scrape, so the best word by word source returned nothing for every track. Its catalog is now looked up through the public iTunes search first, with the old path kept as a fallback

Fix: artist matching ignored non-Latin names entirely. A Japanese, Korean, Chinese or Cyrillic artist did not match even itself, which disqualified results for exactly the tracks that most need a romanization

Fix: a search hit now has to agree with the track before it is used. Duration, live and remix and karaoke markers, and the artist are all checked, so a cover, a different take, or a same-title song by someone else can no longer be served as your track
Fix: titles that carry their credits inline, common on Vocaloid and doujin uploads, now resolve. Bracketed credits are stripped and a name written twice in two scripts is tried each way
Fix: store watermarks that Apple prepends to some tracks no longer appear as the opening lyric
The lyrics cache is versioned, so matching and parsing fixes reach tracks you have already played without clearing anything by hand. Sources you picked yourself are kept
Primary menu rebuilt to follow the GNOME Human Interface Guidelines, and context menus are now consistent across the app
Dynamic cover color, the blurred background and overall contrast reworked. Controls that float over album art use the standard overlay treatment so they stay legible against any cover
Sort playlists by view count and by recently added
Memory: capped glibc malloc arenas, which stops resident memory climbing with every track change, and bounded the memory the UI holds
Navigation is faster: duplicate pages are no longer pushed onto the stack, and page content loads after the push animation rather than during it. History loads asynchronously
Fix: YouTube streams that refused to seek are now seekable, and PO-token handling is more robust
Fix: offline status checks no longer freeze the interface
Fix: Discord Rich Presence leaked a thread indefinitely. There is also a new option to hide it while paused
Fix: playlist caching corrections around Liked Music, mixes, and track counts taken from the real track list
Fix: songs with long names failed to download
Fix: search bar inconsistency, a double-loading delay, and unnecessary queue rebuilds. Clicking a song in a playlist that is already queued now skips to it instead of rebuilding the queue
Visualizer detects whether the spectrum is linear or dB and normalizes accordingly
New Stream Info panel under Preferences for diagnosing playback problems
Flatpak now builds with Nuitka, and AUR packaging ships the PO-token plugins

description.p: Gapless playback, a rewritten visualizer that syncs to the audio automatically, and a wave of fixes targeting the freezes and hangs that made big playlists feel sluggish.

ul.li: Gapless playback for queued tracks: when the next track's stream URL is already cached (downloaded files, or any track after the first in an album), playbin transitions without re-creating the pipeline — no audible gap between tracks

Visualizer now syncs to the audio out of the box: replaced the signal-based dispatch with a position-keyed pull queue that returns the spectrum frame the audio sink is actually playing right now. Works correctly across PipeWire, PulseAudio, and Bluetooth without needing manual latency calibration
Visualizer bars now decay to zero on pause instead of freezing on the last frame
Plain (unsynced) lyrics now render every line at full brightness instead of dimmed, so it's visually clear there's no active cursor to follow
Fix: opening a playlist with Wi-Fi off no longer freezes the UI for 30+ seconds. The library-saved check is now non-blocking and the menu corrects itself once the background populate lands
Fix: intermittent ~800ms UI hang when clicking a song or pressing next/previous. GStreamer state-change calls (which can block on HTTP socket teardown) now run on a worker thread

Fix: opening a big playlist online no longer stutters the slide-in animation. Disk-cache tail splice is chunked and delayed by 350ms to match the offline path's timing, and the live-data auto-refresh is delayed by 2 seconds so it doesn't fight the transition
Fix: per-row cover fetches no longer fire redundant web requests for downloaded tracks (local cover is now authoritative). Cuts hundreds of fetches when opening a big mostly-downloaded playlist
Fix: custom playlist cover URLs (i.ytimg.com/pl_c/…) now keep their signing parameters, so library tiles fetch on the first try instead of failing and falling back to the original URL

Fix: setting a queue with a large playlist no longer freezes the UI for ~800ms creating per-track carousel covers. The current viewport is created synchronously, the rest stream in via low-priority idle ticks
Fix: visualizer no longer desyncs
Fix: gapless transitions no longer drop the artist name or cover art on the next track. Both load paths now share the same metadata normalization

Fix: lyric matching is much stricter for generic-titled tracks. Providers must verify the result's artist matches the playing track before returning lyrics, so "Intro" / "Outro" / "Interlude" / "Track 01" no longer pick up some unrelated album's text
Fix: queue rows now show a subtle hover highlight in blurred-cover mode — previously the catch-all transparency rule wiped out libadwaita's default tint and the rows didn't read as clickable

description.p: New home feed, built-in visualizer, smarter Add to Playlist, and a wave of visual polish around blurred cover backgrounds and the dynamic accent color. And of course bug fixes.

ul.li: Personalized home feed with curated sections, speed-dial tiles, and direct playback from any row
New built-in spectrum visualizer (CAVA-style falling bars) above the expanded player, with bar count (up to 100) and smoothing intensity configurable in Preferences
Add to Playlist replaced with a custom popover featuring playlist covers, type-to-search, and recently-used sorting - much better for libraries with many playlists
Swap music-video tracks (OMV/UGC) to their audio (ATV) counterparts on play, downloads, and Add to Playlist - cleaner metadata and album mastering instead of music-video audio
Player bar: marquee-scrolling titles instead of ellipsis, and non-essential controls (like, queue, volume) fold into an overflow menu on mid-sized windows so the title is always visible
Material You-like color extraction from cover art for dynamic coloring throughout the UI.
Blurred background for main window using current cover art
Multi-select toolbar: Select All / Deselect All actions, with an overflow menu so the bulk-action toolbar fits comfortably on mobile widths
Track playback errors (unavailable, region-locked, removed) now show a toast with the reason and auto-advance to the next track instead of hanging
Uploaded tracks are now fully seekable - they stream from a RAM-backed temporary file instead of YouTube's broken range-request URL, and clean up on track change
Fix: opening a large playlist with many downloaded tracks no longer stalls the UI - download-status lookups now hit an in-memory cache instead of running a SQLite query per row
Fix: partial playlist fetches no longer overwrite a previously-cached full track list on disk
Fix: secondary HTTP range requests on streams now carry cookies and User-Agent so authenticated playback doesn't drop mid-song

Fix: desktop cover view now fills the full available area regardless of source thumbnail resolution - low-res video frames are upscaled like song covers instead of being centered at their tiny native size

Fix: when a YouTube thumbnail 404s and the app falls back to a lower-resolution variant, that working URL is now also propagated to Discord Rich Presence so it stops trying to load the dead maxresdefault URL
Quieter logs: removed the yt-dlp verbose flag and a wave of leftover debug prints

description.p: Major feature update with UI changes, history, and more.

ul.li: Complete UI overhaul for better desktop experience and consistent maximum width for the view contents
History implemented
New Avatar icon replaces the hamburger menu
Discord RPC: added more options in the settings to customize appearence
Play Next and Add to Queue options in song context menus, playlist row context menus, and playlist/album header menus
More caching for better performance and responsiveness
Added preferences to change renderer in case of GPU acceleration issues
Added preference to control sidebar position (left/right).
Added preference for folder structure in downloads.
Added ability to search within library
Added ability to change between grid and list view for library
Fixed bug where download would override M3U with incomplete tracklist
Added expanded cover view for large screens
Added refresh to some pages
Smaller fixes

description.p: New app icon, Discord RPC improvements, queue management, and bug fixes.

ul.li: New app icon with proper symbolic and devel variants
Windows ICO now has transparency and all standard resolutions (16-256px)
Discord RPC: fix status display field name (status_display_type) so artist/song shows under username
Discord RPC: configurable status display type (app name, artist, or song title) in preferences
Discord RPC: enable/disable toggle in preferences with connection status indicator
Discord RPC: album name now shown in rich presence instead of repeating song title
Play Next and Add to Queue options in song context menus, playlist row context menus, and playlist/album header menus
Album name displayed in search results alongside artist
Missing album names fetched in background for search results
Refresh Metadata option in song row and expanded player menus
Maybe fixed: playlist background fetch race condition that could cause segfaults

description.p: Discord Rich Presence support and a stack of stability fixes around fast skipping, the queue, and the explore page.

ul.li: Discord Rich Presence: now playing track with album art, small Mixtapes icon, and live progress bar (cross-platform: Linux, macOS, Windows)
Start Radio from any playlist or album via the more menu
Fast-skip stability: spamming next no longer wraps the queue back to the first track
Fix: clicking a song in a playlist could silently play the first track when the click target wasn't found in the queue
Fix: removing a song from the queue now updates the queue panel immediately instead of waiting for the next track change
Fix: rare segfault when switching songs from the queue panel
Fix: volume could snap back to 100% on track change due to a spurious GStreamer notify-volume during pipeline rebuilds
Explore tab now retries automatically on transient network errors at startup and shows a manual retry button if it still fails
Expanded player carousel no longer drags playback back to the first track when songs are skipped rapidly

description.p: This update adds the ability to download songs as local files with all the metadata and offline listening, as well as Charts in the Explore page.
Major feature update with library management, uploads, and performance improvements.

ul.li: Changed versioning scheme for Alpha releases to YYYY-MM-DD.p where p is the patch number
Stream URL caching for instant song replay and pre-caching of surrounding queue songs
Multi-select songs in playlists with bulk actions (add to playlist, remove, play selected)
Sort playlists by title, artist, album, or duration with ascending/descending toggle
Search within playlists now covers all tracks, not just loaded ones
Save and unsave albums and playlists to your library
Saved albums section in the library
Upload songs to YouTube Music
Uploaded music tab with albums, artists, and all-songs view
Delete individual uploaded songs and albums with confirmation
Start radio from any song, artist, or search result
Artist page now shows full videos list, playlists, featured on, and fans might also like sections
YouTube channel support (non-artist channels with playlists and videos)
Read more/show less for long descriptions on album, playlist, and artist pages
Copy link with toast notification across the app
Add to playlist from queue panel and expanded player
Playlist duration calculated from all tracks, not just loaded ones
Background playback - music continues when window is closed, reopen via MPRIS
Volume slider now matches system mixer percentage with bidirectional sync
Fixed volume feedback loop that could freeze the system
Fixed song activation playing wrong track due to expanded player carousel race condition
Fixed queue panel selection issues causing unintended track changes
Responsive cover art sizing with proper desktop and mobile dimensions
Consistent search result row heights
Custom playlist cover upload support fixed
